description: Where the organization stands in its review cycle, and what is due. Call it first in any session about follow-up or a review, and at every heartbeat. Returns: today (UTC, current quarter and month), the calendar of reviews ahead (scheduled, or expected from the cadence frequency), the last completed reviews with their decisions, and the items due: reviews to prepare (7 days ahead, 1 for weekly ones), reviews held but never recorded, cadences with no review scheduled, KPIs missing the reading of the last closed period, initiatives without a progress update within the review rhythm, overdue actions. Each item has a stable key and the date it became due: pass since (the time of your previous call) to get only what is new, so a recurring agent never acts twice on the same item. get_help topic "heartbeat" says, for each kind of item, which tool to call and what to submit to a person first.

horizon_days.description: How far ahead the calendar looks, in days (1 to 180, default 30).

matrix_id.description: Limit indicators, initiatives and actions to one matrix (from list_matrices). Reviews and cadences are organization-wide.

since.description: ISO date or datetime of your previous call: only items that became due after it are listed (openCount still counts them all).
